question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Hideous
solution:
The correct answer is **'Attractive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'****Hideous'** means extremely ugly or unpleasant.(भयंकर)

 
 
• **Example**: *She saw a hideous face at the window and screamed.*
 
 
 
• The word '**Attractive'** means pleasing, appealing to look at, or arousing interest.(आकर्षक)
 
 
• **Example**: *She is a very attractive lady.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 1'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: **'****Restorative'** means having the ability to restore something.(मज़बूत कर देनेवाला)
 
• **Option 3**: **'****Lament' **means a passionate expression of grief or sorrow.(विलाप)
 
• **Option 4**: **'****Healthful'** means favorable to the health of mind or body.(स्वस्थ)
